raw_text:
PLAN "12-Week Pregnancy Strength Programme"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Maintain strength and stability through pregnancy while staying within safety guidelines"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Foundation & posture":
        warmup:
          cycle 5 minutes low-intensity
        main straight_sets:
          Squat, goblet 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          Split squat with chair 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          Dumbbell bench press (supported, neutral grip) 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          Lat pulldown (or seated row) 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          Pallof press standing 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip flexor stretch 60 seconds
          thoracic mobility 2 minutes
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Progress & stability":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Goblet squat 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          Romanian deadlift with light dumbbells 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          Incline push-up (against bench) 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          Seated cable row 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          Farmer’s carry (short) 3x40 seconds rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          cat-cow 2 minutes
          breathing drills 2 minutes
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Add control":
        warmup:
          bike 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Front squat (light) 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          Split squat with dumbbells 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          Dumbbell bench press (neutral) 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          Seated row 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          Pallof press 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip opener 60 seconds
          lat stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Deload prep":
        warmup:
          brisk walk 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Goblet squat 3x8..12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          Step-up to bench 3x8..12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          Push-up (knees) 3x8..12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          Seated dumbbell row 3x8..12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          Pallof press 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility flow 5 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Strength progression":
        warmup:
          cycle 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Goblet squat 4x6..10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          Romanian deadlift with dumbbells 4x6..10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          Incline press (neutral grip) 4x6..10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          Seated row 4x6..10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          Pallof press 4x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          pigeon pose 60 seconds each side
          diaphragmatic breathing 3 minutes
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Load management":
        warmup:
          bike 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Front squat 4x6..10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          Step-up to bench 4x6..10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          Push-up (knee) 4x6..10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          Seated cable row 4x6..10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          Pallof press 4x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip flexor release 60 seconds
          lat stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Stability & control":
        warmup:
          brisk walk 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Goblet squat 4x6..10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          Romanian deadlift 4x6..10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          Push-up (incline) 4x6..10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          Seated row 4x6..10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          Pallof press 4x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          child's pose 60 seconds
          breathing drills 3 minutes
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Deload & mobility":
        warmup:
          easy bike 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Goblet squat 3x8..12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          Split squat with chair 3x8..12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          Dumbbell bench press (supported) 3x8..12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          Seated row 3x8..12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          Pallof press 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility flow 5 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Strength peak focus":
        warmup:
          cycle 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Goblet squat 5x5 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Romanian deadlift 5x5 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Incline press 5x5 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Seated row 5x5 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Pallof press 4x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip opener 60 seconds
          breathing drills 3 minutes
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Volume maintenance":
        warmup:
          cycle 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Front squat 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Split squat 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Push-up (knees) 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Seated row 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Pallof press 4x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility sequence 5 minutes
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Performance maintenance":
        warmup:
          brisk walk 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Goblet squat 5x5 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Romanian deadlift 5x5 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Dumbbell bench press 5x5 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Seated row 5x5 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Pallof press 4x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          posterior chain mobility 5 minutes
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Recovery & prep for postpartum":
        warmup:
          easy bike 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Goblet squat 3x8..12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          Step-up to bench 3x8..12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          Push-up (knee) 3x8..12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          Seated row 3x8..12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          Pallof press 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          full-body stretch 5 minutes
          breathing & relaxation 5 minutes

Notes:
- Avoid supine positions after week 16; ensure any needs are monitored, and adjust positions to be seated or side-lying as needed.
- No max attempts; all loads are submaximal and controlled.
- No contact sports.
- RPE targets approximate perceived exertion on a 1–10 scale; adjust if breathlessness or dizziness occurs.
- Exercise substitutions available on request to accommodate discomfort, pelvic floor considerations, or oral/medical restrictions.
- Frequency: 1 training session per week per phase; can add light accessory work or mobility on other days as tolerated, but main plan emphasizes safety and progressive strength.
